spec.note: fail-loud off-box dump (SKMEM_BACKUP_OFFBOX). Only off-node copy of the 33k-node AGE graph. Dumps must not land only on the box they protect (theme 4).
spec.revert: restore prior spec generation: re-apply the previous manifest generation (skfleet apply -f the prior JSON; write_spec bumps generation, so the prior generation is the authoritative rollback target). Declarative and reversible by spec regeneration; no imperative rollback script.
spec.retired: Retired 2026-11-11 (SKBrain CmdbDriftBounded triage): Chef decided skmem-pg is derived and is recreated from the flat files, not restored, so it keeps ONE local dump and nothing off-site (skmemory docs/BACKUP_SOP.md, skos jobs.yaml). Re-declared as skmem-pg-backup; the flat source goes off-site via memory-backup.
